fields.label: Sections
fields.name: page_layouts
fields.instructions: Build the page from sections. Each renders template-parts/blocks/{layout}.php.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: A short label above the heading. Optional.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: The page's main heading (h1).

sub_fields.label: Badges
sub_fields.name: badges
sub_fields.instructions: Proof marks under the buttons, e.g. a standard (EN 795) or an accreditation.

sub_fields.label: Beside the text
sub_fields.name: panel
sub_fields.instructions: The solution finder is set up once, in Site Settings › Solution finder.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: A short label above the heading. Optional.

sub_fields.label: Ticked points
sub_fields.name: points
sub_fields.instructions: Short lines, shown as a ticked list.

sub_fields.label: Second button
sub_fields.name: button_2
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for no button.

sub_fields.label: Section link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: A link under the heading, e.g. "All solutions".

sub_fields.label: Tag
sub_fields.name: tag
sub_fields.instructions: A small label above the title, e.g. "6 systems" or "EN 795".

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Also the link text, so keep titles distinct.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Decorative: the title names the card.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: A Font Awesome name, e.g. fa-helmet-safety. Shown when there is no image.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: A short label above the heading. Optional.

sub_fields.label: Secondary button
sub_fields.name: button_2
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to show the phone number from Site Settings.

sub_fields.label: Side card heading
sub_fields.name: aside_heading
sub_fields.instructions: Optional card beside the questions, e.g. "Still have a question?". Leave empty for none.

sub_fields.label: Accreditations
sub_fields.name: badges
sub_fields.instructions: A row of accreditations under the figures (a trust bar).

sub_fields.label: Logo
sub_fields.name: logo
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. The name is its alt text.

sub_fields.label: Tag
sub_fields.name: tag
sub_fields.instructions: A small label, e.g. "Free".

sub_fields.label: Button
sub_fields.name: button_1
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for no button.

sub_fields.label: Logos
sub_fields.name: logos
sub_fields.instructions: Each logo's alt text (Media Library) should name the organisation.

sub_fields.label: Reassurance points
sub_fields.name: points
sub_fields.instructions: Short lines beside the form, e.g. "We reply within one working day".

sub_fields.label: Show phone and email
sub_fields.name: show_contact
sub_fields.instructions: From Site Settings › Contact.

sub_fields.label: Where the answers come from
sub_fields.message: The questions, options and recommendations are set once, in Site Settings › Solution finder, so this row and the hero panel always agree.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the first question as the heading.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: A short label above the heading. Optional.

sub_fields.label: Quote
sub_fields.name: quote
sub_fields.instructions: Optional client quote.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Alt text comes from the Media Library.

sub_fields.label: Button
sub_fields.name: button_1
sub_fields.instructions: Usually the full case study.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Names the tab when there is more than one scene, e.g. "Rooftop", "Warehouse".

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: A photo or drawing. Its alt text (Media Library) should describe the whole scene. Select a spot below, then click this preview to place it.

sub_fields.label: Spots
sub_fields.name: spots
sub_fields.instructions: Numbered in this order, on the image and in the list beside it.

sub_fields.label: Across %
sub_fields.name: x
sub_fields.instructions: Click the image to set.

sub_fields.label: Table heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: E.g. "Dimensions". Optional for a single table.

sub_fields.label: Downloads
sub_fields.name: files
sub_fields.instructions: Data sheets, drawings, certificates.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: E.g. "Installation guide".

sub_fields.label: Note
sub_fields.name: note
sub_fields.instructions: One line, e.g. "Updated March 2026".

sub_fields.label: Cover image
sub_fields.name: cover
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Decorative.

sub_fields.label: From category
sub_fields.name: category
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for all.

sub_fields.label: Section link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: A link under the heading, e.g. "All articles".
